M1, corrected (security S18-1, MAJOR; spec S18-1, S18-2). CI's install-step flags do not stop install-time code. An install with --ignore-scripts records the skipped projects as pendingBuilds in node_modules/.modules.yaml. pnpm 11 then runs an install before every pnpm <script>, with no flag, and that install runs the pending lifecycle scripts. pnpm also loads the pnpmfile for every command, and only ignorePnpmfile stops it; the flag is set on the install step only. In CI both channels therefore run one step later, before boundaries:check. Evidence: the security record (issue 8 comment 5980328179); the orchestrator's reproduction in the R17-1-20261004T0844 run notes (plant clone 482246a: no marker after the flagged install, all four markers after one pnpm validate:records; pnpm_config_ignore_scripts=true plus pnpm_config_ignore_pnpmfile=true in the environment stopped them); and this round's BOM probe, in which a pnpmfile wrote no marker during the flagged install and then wrote 'pnpmfile:boundaries:check;pnpmfile:install;' inside pnpm boundaries:check. What holds: the flags cover the install step only, and the pins carry the weight. This supersedes, by name, the round-eighteen checkpoint's assumption at line 146 ('CI's --ignore-scripts (PR 16) now stops every install-time script at the source, whatever the pins say'), its declared_non_coverage lesson at line 165 ('CI's --ignore-pnpmfile (PR 16, 9e5ac41) is what stops a pnpmfile from running in CI'), and DEC-045's rationale ('CI's --ignore-pnpmfile (PR 16) is the source fix'). The round-eighteen checkpoint and DEC-045 are not edited. The job-wide fix is human-only and open (see blockers).

M1, two count and claim corrections (spec S18-1, S18-2). The round-eighteen checkpoint's 'eleven key-spelling plants' is ten: pnpmfile in three new spellings, globalPnpmfile in four and pnpmfileChecksum in three new ones. With ten, that line's tally gives 414, as CI and DEC-045's '21 more' do. The round-eighteen checkpoint also says that the pnpm-file and PNPMFILE keys are refused as other pnpmfile keys. Only PNPMFILE was: the round-eighteen pin is /pnpmfile/i, which does not match pnpm-file. pnpm 11.9.0 ignored pnpm-file (spec S18-2 probe), so nothing was exposed. Since M2, the workspace allowlist refuses pnpm-file in pnpm-workspace.yaml as it refuses any other key.

M2, fixed (controls C18-2; security S18-2, S18-3, S18-4; code CR18-3). tests/boundaries/ci-workflow.test.mjs adds 'install lifecycle: pnpm-workspace.yaml sets no top-level key but packages and overrides', read with topLevelKeys. nodeOptions became NODE_OPTIONS for every pnpm <script> and ran code inside boundaries:check, and patchedDependencies rewrote dependency-cruiser's bin, each after CI's flagged install with the round-eighteen tests green. The per-key and per-spelling pins are kept as named witnesses.

M3, fixed (code CR18-1; controls C18-1). In scripts/install-surface.mjs, topLevelKeys treats only a space or # as marking a line that is not a key. A line led by a byte-order mark, a tab or other whitespace now throws, and the read tests go red. Before, JavaScript's \s matched U+FEFF, so a BOM-led first line was skipped while pnpm 11.9.0 stripped the BOM and read the key. A unit test witnesses the refusal.
M4, fixed (code CR18-2). A test that a double-quoted key with an escape JSON does not know (YAML's x66 escape for f) throws, and a mutation that loosens the decoder's catch to return the body.
